svg.title: Horosa Skill architecture
svg.desc: Four layers: AI clients reach the local Horosa Skill process over MCP or the CLI; it gates, dispatches and documents each call, computes on the offline runtime (Java backend, Python chart service, Node headless JS) and stores every run locally.
svg.text: Four layers — by default, nothing leaves your machine
missing time / place / timezone / gender / school → ask the user, never guess
BaZi · Zi Wei · Da Liu Ren
Upstream: the open-source Horosa tree → vendor/ (one-way sync)
Distribution: GitHub Releases (runtime · wheel · .mcpb) · MCP Registry
